Recap /recap/S3L6Vz6t6pk (freshly issued share token for Alert Test — old fixture token efc6VHgvHCo from iter9 no longer exists so a new token was created via the trips list): dark background is deep navy rgb(10,37,64) = #0A2540 (verified in DOM), slide title 'THE DAMAGE / ₹5,600 well spent.' rendered in Cormorant Garamond, all 9 recap testids present (recap-page, recap-close-btn, recap-slide-title, recap-prev-btn, recap-playpause-btn, recap-next-btn, recap-music-btn, recap-whatsapp-btn, recap-download-btn), next-btn click advances slide, download menu opens with Video (.webm) + Image set (.zip) options — no console errors on the recap page after the invalid-token fix. NO functional or visual regressions from iterations 1-9. No pageerror thrown on any page. The recurring 401s in console are the anonymous GET /api/auth/me on public pages (Landing/Auth) which is expected — backend returns 401 to signal 'no session', frontend handles gracefully. og.png backend endpoint not re-verified per request (main agent already confirmed 200).
